trending.name: lvgl
trending.author: kisvegabor
trending.sentence: Full-featured Graphics Library for Embedded Systems
trending.paragraph: Powerful and easy-to-use embedded GUI with many widgets, advanced visual effects (opacity, antialiasing, animations) and low memory requirements (16K RAM, 64K Flash).

trending.name: FastLED
trending.author: Daniel Garcia
trending.sentence: Multi-platform library for controlling dozens of different types of LEDs along with optimized math, effect, and noise functions.
trending.paragraph: FastLED is a fast, efficient, easy-to-use Arduino library for programming addressable LED strips and pixels such as WS2810, WS2811, LPD8806, Neopixel and more. FastLED also provides high-level math functions that can be used for generative art and graphics.

trending.paragraph: Library for configuring ESP8266/ESP32 modules WiFi credentials and custom parameters at runtime with captive portal.

trending.name: ArduinoJson
trending.author: Benoit Blanchon <blog.benoitblanchon.fr>
trending.sentence: A simple and efficient JSON library for embedded C++.
trending.paragraph: ⭐ 7124 stars on GitHub! Supports serialization, deserialization, MessagePack, streams, filtering, and more. Fully tested and documented.

trending.name: Blinker
trending.author: i3water
trending.sentence: Build a easy way for your IoT project.
trending.paragraph: Blinker library for embedded hardware. Support Arduino, ESP8266, ESP32, WiFi, BLE, MQTT.

trending.author: shirriff, z3t0, ArminJo
trending.sentence: Send and receive infrared signals with multiple protocols
trending.paragraph: Currently included protocols: Denon / Sharp, JVC, LG,  NEC / Onkyo / Apple, Panasonic / Kaseikyo, RC5, RC6, Samsung, Sony, (Pronto), BangOlufsen, BoseWave, Lego, Whynter, FAST, MagiQuest, Velux, Universal Pulse Distance and Pulse Width.

trending.name: TFT_eSPI

trending.name: PubSubClient
trending.author: Nick O'Leary <nick.oleary@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: A client library for MQTT messaging.
trending.paragraph: MQTT is a lightweight messaging protocol ideal for small devices. This library allows you to send and receive MQTT messages. It supports the latest MQTT 3.1.1 protocol and can be configured to use the older MQTT 3.1 if needed. It supports all Arduino Ethernet Client compatible hardware, including the Intel Galileo/Edison, ESP8266 and TI CC3000.

trending.name: Blynk

trending.paragraph: Simple library intended for hobby comunity to run the BLDC and Stepper motor using FOC algorithm. It is intended to support as many BLDC/Stepper motor+sensor+driver combinations as possible and in the same time maintain simplicity of usage. Library supports Arudino devices such as Arduino UNO, MEGA, NANO and similar, stm32 boards such as Nucleo and Bluepill, ESP32 and Teensy boards.

hidden_gems.name: ESPNowUtilities
hidden_gems.author: Christoph Streit <christoph.streit@gmail.com>
hidden_gems.sentence: Paired, single-peer ESP-NOW links between two ESP32 boards.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Wraps ESP-NOW in a connection class that handles discovery and pairing, tracks one peer with a liveness timeout, and carries application messages of your own definition. The wire format of those messages is yours; the library only routes them and confirms they came from the paired peer.

hidden_gems.name: SoundEngine
hidden_gems.author: Christoph Streit <christoph.streit@gmail.com>
hidden_gems.sentence: Play short WAV sound effects on an ESP32 through an I2S DAC.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Mixes any number of 16-bit PCM clips embedded in flash and streams them to an I2S amplifier from its own background task, so playback never blocks the sketch. Clips carry their own volume and can repeat; a master gain sits on top. Three sounds are built in and three more ship ready to include.

hidden_gems.name: UpdateOTW
hidden_gems.author: Ítalo Coelho
hidden_gems.sentence: Peer-to-peer firmware update over the wire (Modbus RTU / RS485).
hidden_gems.paragraph: Stream a firmware image from a Modbus RTU master to a slave over a half-duplex RS485 bus, and the slave reboots into it. Two register-array state machines (UpdateOTW_Master sender, UpdateOTW_Slave receiver) — your code keeps doing the Modbus, the library only reads/writes a small register window. Non-blocking (one frame per tick), so the device keeps running while it updates, with deferred apply. Per-chunk CRC16 plus full-image CRC32, automatic retry with patient back-off, and free rollback via the ESP32 Update library. No external dependencies.

hidden_gems.name: ADRF6655

Designed for ESP32 control of the ADRF6655 evaluation board over SPI.
